note: Set B is better because it correctly identifies the relative thickness of 20% at the blade tip (r/R=1.0), whereas Set A incorrectly binds this value to the root (r/R=0.0). Both sets contain significant errors, including hallucinating a 100m chord length (likely confusing the thickness axis) and missing the negative sign on prebend values. Both also tend to extract axis limits (e.g., 30% pitch, 0m chord) rather than the actual plotted values at the specified span locations.
remarks: Both extractors struggle with plot interpretation, frequently misreading axis scales or confusing labels between subplots (e.g. assigning the 100% thickness axis limit to chord length).
